chunks: Even if a whiff of the Lord's chastisement were to touch them they would surely say: 'Ah woe, alas, we were surely sinful.'
ai.seo_question: What do disbelievers say when they feel a taste of God's punishment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of *Zalim* (wrongdoer) as one who harms oneself through denial of divine truth, emphasizing that the punishment is a consequence of their own choices rather than arbitrary divine wrath. The phrase 'even a slight taste' (*nafhatun*) suggests that the full severity of the Hereafter is yet to come, serving as a warning to believers to reflect before it is too late. This moment of regret highlights the transition from arrogance in worldly life to humility in the face of divine justice.
